## Personality

Julia Bell is known for putting on airs, particularly regarding her mother's parlor. This behavior has been a distinct aspect of her personality since earlier in the story.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P20](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0020)_

## History

Julia Bell is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who returned to school alongside her peers to welcome [Anne](../character/anne.md) back after a brief absence. She later participated in school life under the instruction of Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), who introduced plans for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. Julia also became a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), attending its meetings to discuss community matters such as local advertising concerns.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P6](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P7](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0007), +62 more_
